name: the-mules-court
description: A Love Letter-style card game of deduction, risk, and elimination set in Isaac Asimov's Foundation universe, built with Phaser.
author: Cornelius Donley <admin@tuesdaycrowd.com>

scripts.build: bunx --bun vite build --config vite/config.prod.mjs && bun run generate:assets
scripts.test: bun run test:engine && bun run test:server && bun run test:mcp
scripts.compile: bun run build && bun build --compile --bytecode --outfile mules-court src/server/standalone.ts
scripts.compile:darwin-arm64: bun run build && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist-bin/mules-court-darwin-arm64 src/server/standalone.ts
scripts.compile:darwin-x64: bun run build && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist-bin/mules-court-darwin-x64 src/server/standalone.ts
scripts.compile:linux-x64: bun run build && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist-bin/mules-court-linux-x64 src/server/standalone.ts
scripts.compile:linux-arm64: bun run build && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist-bin/mules-court-linux-arm64 src/server/standalone.ts
scripts.compile:windows-x64: bun run build && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist-bin/mules-court-windows-x64.exe src/server/standalone.ts
